{{Quote|Got yourself a project in mind?|Khom Great speaks to a customer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>}}
'''Khom Grelt''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He made his living as a decorations engineer on board [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

Gelt had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin with a darker blue pattern on his [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khom Grelt first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', a expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]], as a utility decorations engineer aboard Carrick Station.<ref name="SWTOR" />
